// Default workshop variant used by quarkus:dev and the @QuarkusTest surefire tests, which read
// the live content/ directory. The Maven build generates a tailored options.adoc per variant
// combination into target/content/variants/<name>/ (via generate-variants.java at generate-sources)
// and passes site.content-dir=target/content so Roq picks those up instead.
//
// This file is regenerated from data/variants.json by the generate-variant-structure Maven execution
// (--defaults flag). Do not edit by hand; change data/variants.json instead.
:buildtool: maven
:os: all
:use-ai:
:use-cli:
:use-container:
:use-kubernetes:
:use-messaging:
:use-native:
